: Hi! I’m not much of a coffee drinker, so I was wondering if you had any recommendations? And also if you’d like to talk to me about what happened now.
lines.zh: : 你好！我不太喝咖啡，所以想问问你有什么推荐？另外，你现在愿意跟我聊聊那天发生的事了吗？

lines.en: : This is a place of business, not a psychiatrist’s office. Let alone {i}my{/i} psychiatrist’s office. So you can either order something or you can leave. We’re too busy today for this.
lines.zh: : 这里是做生意的地方，不是心理医生的诊室。更不是{i}我的{/i}心理医生的诊室。所以你要么点东西，要么出去。今天太忙了，没空陪你折腾。

lines.en: : Then, is there a time you go on break so I can come back around then?

lines.zh: : 我今天没有休息时间。我最好的咖啡师正在休假，人手本来就不够。

lines.en: : In that case, I’d like to apply for a job. And I’m ready for my interview right now!

lines.en: : Hah...{i}please,{/i} just get out of line. I told you I’m fine and that I do not need your help with anything. At all. And I likely never will, so-
lines.zh: : 哈……{i}求你了{/i}，别排队了。我说了我很好，什么事都不需要你帮。一点都不需要。而且以后大概也永远不需要，所以——

lines.en: : I’ll have what she’s having. I want to spend some quality time with the cafe lady too. I’ve heard {i}stories{/i} about this place.

lines.zh: : 你当时倒在大路边上，靠在一张长椅上，衣服只穿了一半，浑身都是体液。

lines.en: : Yeah, and some people {i}like{/i} that! I just happen to be one of them! And if you involve yourself in this any more, we could {i}both{/i} get in serious trouble!
lines.zh: : 是啊，可有些人就{i}喜欢{/i}那样！我刚好就是其中一个！你要是再掺和进来，我们{i}两个{/i}都会惹上大麻烦！

lines.en: : This isn’t a thing we can talk about! I don’t {i}want{/i} to talk about it! And there’s no way in hell your parents would allow it, so-
lines.zh: : 这种事我们没法谈！我{i}不想{/i}谈！而且你父母绝对不可能同意，所以——

lines.en: scene karinharucafe12

lines.en: : I was lucky enough to walk away from that encounter unscathed, but the same can’t be said for everyone. Which is why, if there is anything I can do to help you, I {i}want{/i} to. No, I {i}need{/i} to.

lines.en: : Why are you so against someone caring about you?

lines.en: : Even if what you say is true and you were {i}not{/i} some sort of victim that night, I can not allow myself to sit idly by and watch as you belittle yourself in such a way.

lines.en: scene karinharucafe19
: You’re a human being, Haruka. Even the most deplorable people of {i}all{/i} shouldn’t be casting aside their self-worth as if it’s {i}nothing.{/i}

lines.zh: : 我不想听你讲你{i}妹妹{/i}！我不{i}在乎{/i}你妹妹！我在乎的是你天天往我的事里钻，把时间浪费在一个没救的人身上！

lines.en: : You want to make a difference, Karin?! Help someone who needs it! Not someone who fucks up for the {i}sake{/i} of fucking up just because she can’t stand it when no one is looking at her!
lines.zh: : 你想改变点什么，是吗，Karin？！去帮需要帮助的人！而不是帮那种只为{i}搞砸{/i}而搞砸、只因为受不了没人看她的人！

lines.en: : But {i}I’m{/i} looking at you...
lines.zh: : 可是{i}我{/i}在看着你啊……

lines.en: scene karinharucafe21
: I know...
lines.zh: : 我知道……

lines.en: : So isn’t this exactly what you want?
lines.zh: : 那这不正是你想要的吗？

lines.en: : It {i}should{/i} be. But it’s {i}not.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}本该{/i}是。可{i}并不是{/i}。

lines.en: : Now, get the fuck out of my store or I’ll have you trespassed.
lines.zh: : 现在，滚出我的店，不然我就告你非法入侵。

lines.en: : Haruka-
lines.zh: : Haruka——

lines.en: : {i}Now.{/i}
scene karinharucafe22
: I said {i}now.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我说了{i}现在{/i}。

lines.en: : I’ll be back again tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 我明天还会再来。

lines.en: scene karinharucafe23
: Wha- {i}no!{/i} Were you not listening?! I seriously {i}will{/i} have you trespassed! I’m not kidding!
lines.zh: : 什——{i}不行！{/i}你没在听吗？！我真的{i}会{/i}告你非法入侵！我没在开玩笑！

lines.en: : If a misdemeanor is what it takes to have you reach out and ask for help, it will all be worth it in the end.
lines.zh: : 如果非得让我背个轻罪，才能让你开口求助，那到头来一切都是值得的。

lines.en: scene karinharucafe24
: That sort of optimism is going to be your undoing, you know.
lines.zh: : 你这种乐观迟早会害了你自己，你知道吗。

lines.en: : This world is darker than you think, Karin. You’re choosing a terrible way to learn that right now.
lines.zh: : 这个世界比你想象的要黑暗得多，Karin。你现在选了种很糟糕的方式去认识这一点。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...maybe you’re right about that...
lines.zh: : 嗯，好吧……也许这点你是对的……

lines.en: : Maybe I don’t know what I’m getting myself into. Maybe this is all...bigger and scarier than someone like {i}me{/i} can handle.
lines.zh: : 也许我不知道自己在蹚什么浑水。也许这一切……比{i}我{/i}这种人能承受的更大、更可怕。

lines.en: scene black
: But I need to learn sometime, don’t I?
lines.zh: : 可我总得有学会的一天，不是吗？

lines.en: : And if I can help someone along the way...
lines.zh: : 而如果这一路上我能帮到谁……

lines.en: : I think that lesson will be worth it.
lines.zh: : 我想，这一课就是值得的。

lines.en: : That...you...
: I don’t...I don’t {i}want{/i} you to-
lines.zh: : 我不……我不{i}想{/i}让你——

lines.en: : Same time tomorrow, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 明天同一时间，Haruka。

lines.en: : Have your trespassing order ready.
lines.zh: : 把你的非法入侵禁令准备好。
